title: Part
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. This sketch consists of a single loop made up of seven lines. Begin with the first line starting at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ending at (0.75, 0.0). The second line starts at (0.75, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0033). The third line continues from (0.75, 0.0033) to (0.75, 0.212). The fourth line moves from (0.75, 0.212) to (0.7467, 0.212). The fifth line goes from (0.7467, 0.212) to (0.7467, 0.0033). The sixth line extends from (0.7467, 0.0033) to (0.0, 0.0033). Finally, the seventh line completes the loop by returning from (0.0, 0.0033) to the origin (0.0, 0.0). After drawing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire 2D sketch. Transform the scaled 2D sketch into a three-dimensional object using the same Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the 2D sketch 0.0522 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. Create a new solid body from this extruded part. The dimensions of the final part are approximately 0.75 units in length, 0.212 units in width, and 0.0522 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch for the L-shaped model
r = (
    r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.75, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.75, 0.0033)
    .lineTo(0.75, 0.212)
    .lineTo(0.7467, 0.212)
    .lineTo(0.7467, 0.0033)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0033)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .close()
    .extrude(0.0522)
)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# L-shaped flat strip lying in the XY plane, extruded in Z
# Long leg along X (0.75), short leg along Y (0.212) at the +X end
# Strip width (w) and thickness (Z) small

L_x = 0.7500   # long leg length along X
L_y = 0.2120   # short leg length along Y
t_z = 0.0522   # thickness in Z
w = 0.0300     # strip width in plan

long_leg = cq.Workplane("XY").box(L_x, w, t_z, centered=False)

short_leg = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .transformed(offset=(L_x - w, 0, 0))
    .box(w, L_y, t_z, centered=False)
)

r = long_leg.union(short_leg)

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

w = 0.0522
Lx = 0.7500
Ly = 0.2120
h = 0.0522

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(Lx, 0)
    .lineTo(Lx, Ly)
    .lineTo(Lx - w, Ly)
    .lineTo(Lx - w, w)
    .lineTo(0, w)
    .close()
    .extrude(h)
)
